title: PLAIN STACK reasoning mode subset — v1
status: synthetic matched subset; single pass; not owner-qualified

method.hermes: 0.21.5, isolated candidate API gateway, no HADES overlay
method.runtime: Ollama 0.31.1, same private inference host and endpoint
method.variable: default Hermes reasoning configuration versus per-request model_options.reasoning.enabled=false
method.timing: client first visible content and full streamed request wall; aggregate-only proxy independently captured model request/token metrics
method.cold_start: first ordinary greeting followed gateway startup and isolated profile initialization; retain it in results
method.limitations: single pass; only greeting and arithmetic order alternated; explanation arms ran default then disabled; no owner preference or HADES gateway qualification; model answers judged manually for relevance/correctness, not by automatic text matching

default.manual_review: Natural and relevant. First request/candidate startup behavior is included in this timing.

turns: Can you explain why Python generators are useful?

default.manual_review: Correct, but both turns are more elaborate than the short follow-up needed.

reasoning_disabled.manual_review: Follow-up is correct, concise, and directly addresses why. Initial explanation is correct but adds an unrequested code sample and is more verbose than needed.

interpretation.latency: Reasoning-disabled responses were faster in this sample, especially the explanation follow-up; the initial default-reasoning greeting includes candidate-startup cost and is not an apples-to-apples warm-turn estimate. Keep all observations. More repeats are required.
interpretation.quality: No answer correctness regression was observed in these three synthetic cases. Reasoning-disabled explanation was more verbose on the first turn, but substantially more direct on the one-word follow-up. This is not enough evidence to change the default globally.
